title: LightningUsageByBrowserMetrics - Data API
description: Represents Lightning Experience usage grouped by user’s browser. This object is available in API version 43.0 and later.

Browser.description: Browser used to access Lightning Experience.

PageName.description: Page user viewed in Lightning Experience.

TotalCount.description: Total number of pages accessed in Lightning Experience.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<complexType name="LightningUsageByBrowserMetrics">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="Browser" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="EptBin3To5" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
        <element name="EptBin5To8" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
        <element name="EptBin8To10" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
        <element name="EptBinOver10" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
        <element name="EptBinUnder3" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
        <element name="MetricsDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:date"/>
        <element name="PageName" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="RecordCountEPT" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
        <element name="SumEPT" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
        <element name="SystemModstamp" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="TotalCount" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
```

Id.field_label: Lightning Usage By Browser Metrics ID
